about.heroBody: Fizuli Grill-Resto is a family-run Caucasian grill kitchen in Kehra. Every weekday we cook lunch in the morning, load it hot, and drive it straight to your workplace in Tallinn.
about.story1Body: Every dish is prepared fresh in our Kehra kitchen the morning of delivery — no reheats, no yesterday's food.
about.story2Body: Real charcoal grill. Marinated skewers, homestyle cutlets and grilled salads made the Caucasian way.
about.story3Body: Order by 18:00, and we deliver hot to your Krulli Kvartal office between 11:30 and 13:00 the next day.
about.visitBody: Prefer to eat in? Our restaurant in Kehra is open to walk-in guests. For up-to-date hours, menu specials and photos, follow us on Facebook.
about.ctaBody: Pick your building and grab tomorrow's lunch in under a minute.
